description: This source file defines a static class 'OptionsOverrides' containing extension methods for overriding options using named options in Orleans configuration. It provides methods to retrieve provider-specific ClusterOptions and generic overridable options via dependency injection.

classes.name: OptionsOverrides
classes.description: Contains extension methods for retrieving and overriding Orleans cluster options and other configuration options via dependency injection.

methods.name: GetProviderClusterOptions
methods.description: Extension method to get the ClusterOptions for a specific provider, possibly overridden based on provider name.

methods.name: GetOverridableOption
methods.description: Private generic extension method to retrieve a configurable option instance, falling back to the default options if no specific override is provided.
